crossRefs.note: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
“Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that…
In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be…
Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know…
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
translations.bsb: So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
